# Jay Lewis Realtor

> Real estate agent serving buyers and sellers in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada
> and the surrounding communities of Beaumont, Devon, Fort Saskatchewan,
> Leduc, Morinville, Onoway, Sherwood Park, Spruce Grove, St. Albert, and
> Stony Plain.

Jay Lewis provides residential real estate services including home buying
representation, home selling and listing services, free home evaluations,
and local market guidance across the greater Edmonton region.

Contact: jay@jaysells.ca
Website: https://jaysells.ca/

## Key facts
- Serves both home buyers and sellers
- Coverage area: Edmonton and the surrounding communities listed above
- Offers free, no-obligation home evaluations for sellers
- In Alberta, the seller typically pays commission for both agents, so
  buyer representation typically has no direct cost to the buyer
